newsitem.title: GERMANY: Quinn says punt trading comfortably in ERM band.
newsitem.headline: Quinn says punt trading comfortably in ERM band.

text.p: Former Irish finance minister Ruairi Quinn said on Tuesday that the punt was trading comfortably in the ERM band and said that he did not see any pressure on the currency.
Quinn, speaking to Reuters on the fringes of the Global 24 European Monetary Union conference in Frankfurt, also said that he saw no signs that the Irish economy was overheating.
Quinn said that as he did not belong to the present government, he did not wish to make a precise comment on the likelihood of a punt revaluation.
Rumours that Ireland's new finance minister Charlie McCreevy, who took office last week, might revalue the punt have been circulating in the market in recent days.
"Under the policy which I pursued, the punt traded comfortably within the band. It is still trading quite comfortably in the ERM band," Quinn told Reuters Financial Television (RFTV).
Asked if he saw any pressure on the punt within those bands, Quinn replied: "I don't."
He said the next step in determining the future of the punt would be the issue of how currencies would be fixed to the euro.
